title: How to Run Teach-Back With LEP Patients
summary: Learn how to use teach-back with patients who have limited English proficiency, including interpreter workflow, medication counseling, discharge.
body_markdown:
###


Explain one complete idea, interpret it, ask the patient to explain the plan back in their own words, interpret that response, correct the explanation if needed, and repeat.


###


No. The patient should teach back in the language they can use comfortably. The interpreter should carry the patient's response back to the clinician.


###


A useful prompt is: “I want to make sure I explained this clearly. Can you tell me how you will take this medicine when you get home?”


###


Rephrase the explanation, clarify any interpretation issue, and ask again. Treat a wrong answer as feedback on the communication process before treating it as a patient failure.


###


Yes. AI medical interpretation can support the full teach-back loop when the system supports the language and the interpreted responses remain clear.
